children: Polish central banker Ludwik Kotecki said on Wednesday that the Monetary Policy Council (MPC) is nearing a "serious discussion" about an interest rate hike, which could take place in November.
He added in an interview with RMF FM radio that if rates were to be raised, it would be done in "small steps," signaling a gradual approach to any monetary tightening.
